name: refas
description: Vision-first, evidence-bound reference image to 3D reconstruction with multiview QA and explicit physical semantics.

interface.longDescription: A vision-first reconstruction skill and runtime that lets an agent observe references, build traceable 3D assets, compare actual multiview renders, and close evidence-backed physical semantics without fabricating hidden source truth.
defaultPrompt: Use RefAs to reconstruct this reference as a traceable 3D asset with multiview QA.
Use RefAs to rebuild this reference with evidence-bound geometry and physical semantics where justified.
